title: SOC 2 Cost in 2026: First-Year Total by Headcount
summary: What SOC 2 costs in 2026 by headcount: Agency's published prices ($7,500 to $20,000 flat, audit from $2,500) beside public audit records.
body_markdown:
## Related guides


- [SOC 2 Renewal: Year-Two Cost, Timeline and Changes](https://blog.getagency.com/articles/soc-2-renewal)


A SOC 2 renewal audit through Agency starts at $2,500 in 2026. What repeats in year two, when to start, and a month-by-month calendar.


- [Penetration Testing Cost in 2026: Prices by Scope](https://blog.getagency.com/articles/penetration-testing-cost)


A web app pen test from Agency is $5,000 fixed in 2026. Add-on prices, delivery times, and what moves cost for API, network, cloud and mobile scopes.


- [SOC 2 Audit Cost by Auditor Firm: Price Comparison Data](https://blog.getagency.com/articles/soc-2-audit-cost-by-auditor-firm)


How SOC 2 auditor pricing varies by firm tier, what drives the differences, whether higher cost means better quality, and how to optimize spend.


- [SOC 2 Penetration Test Costs: Scope and Budget (2026)](https://blog.getagency.com/articles/soc-2-penetration-test-cost-2026)


Compare penetration testing scope, methodology, reporting, and retest terms before budgeting for SOC 2 evidence.


- [SOC 2 vs ISO 27001 Cost Comparison: Which Is Cheaper?](https://blog.getagency.com/articles/soc-2-vs-iso-27001-cost-comparison)


Compare SOC 2 and ISO 27001 using scoped implementation, assessment, and ongoing-operation quotes. Neither framework has a universal cost advantage.
